## Step 1: Create the integration

1. Open WSO2 Integrator.
2. Select **Skip for now**.
3. Select **Create New Integration**.
4. Set **Integration Name** to `AuditLogs`.
5. Set **Project Name** to `audit-logs`.
6. Select **Create Integration**.
7. Select **AuditLogs**.

## Step 2: Create a role with audit log access permissions

1. In the WSO2 Cloud Console top navigation, select **Organization**.
2. In the left navigation menu, select **Admin**.
3. Select **Settings**.
4. On the **Access Control** tab, select **Roles**.
5. Select **+ Create Role**.
6. <!-- manual: Enter a name and description for the role. -->
7. Under the **Permissions** list, select **LOG-MANAGEMENT**.
8. Select **Create**.

## Step 3: Create a group and assign the role and user to the group

1. On the **Access Control** tab, select **Groups**.
2. Select **+ Create Group**.
3. <!-- manual: Enter a name and description for the group, then click Create. -->
4. <!-- manual: On the Groups view, on the group you just created, click Edit. -->
5. <!-- manual: Add the user to the group by clicking + Add Users. -->
6. <!-- manual: Assign the role you created in [Step 1](#step-1-create-a-role-with-audit-log-access-permissions) to the group. :::tip If you want to invite one or more users and add them to the Auditor group, follow these steps: 1. Navigate to the Users tab under Access Control. 2. Click + Invite Users. 3. In the Emails field, enter the email addresses of users you want to invite. 4. Click Groups to expand the groups list. Select the group you created. 5. Click Invite. This sends an invitation email to each address so the users can accept and obtain access to view audit logs. ::: -->
